name: M1
note: Main run 1. The bake-off winner (PPO from a random 2x128 network, 45 min, 42 M steps, 91.4% on 500 shared analysis flights) continues: same network, same optimiser state. Stage 1 keeps learning on the real task (it was still improving). Stage 2: hard cases, 30% of flights re-fly real-task seeds it failed on recent checks (each check uses fresh seeds, so later checks stay clean). Stage 3: fine-tune with a lower learning rate and less exploration.

stages.name: real task, keep learning
stages.expect: The check average was still rising (90.8% at 26 M steps -> 93.8% at 39 M). Expect ~95% within 2 hours, boulder hits falling from ~5% to ~3%.

stages.name: hard cases
stages.expect: The remaining failures are rare situations (mostly the boulder 1-2.5 m off centre). Seeing them 30% of the time instead of ~5% should lift them by 1-2 points.

stages.name: fine-tune
stages.expect: Smaller, steadier steps: less noise in the policy, the last point or two.
